tools.name: get_request_form
tools.description: Get the fields and regions for a Bidit category (petal_id from find_category). Ask the customer for required fields not already known. For select fields, use one of the listed options. bid_critical_details lists optional questions that most change a price: ask at most 3 the customer has not already

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Create a draft request on Bidit for the customer. Requires the customer's email: Bidit emails them a confirm link, and businesses are invited only after they click it. Never invent prices or field values. The result includes request_id and access_key: keep both for later calls in this conversation a

tools.name: update_request
tools.description: Change fields, region, description or urgency of a Bidit request that is still a draft (not yet confirmed by the customer). Only send what changed. After fixing validation errors, call submit_request.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Send (or resend) the confirm email for a valid draft Bidit request. Use after fixing validation errors, or if the customer did not receive the email. Businesses are invited only after the customer clicks confirm.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Check a Bidit request: status (draft until the customer confirms by email), number of offers, number of businesses invited, expiry, and the customer's dashboard link.

tools.name: get_bids
tools.description: List the private offers on a confirmed Bidit request. Business names stay hidden until the customer awards. Report amounts exactly as returned; never estimate. Each offer has licence_verified: say 'Licence verified' or 'Licence not yet verified by Bidit' accordingly. business_written_summary is text

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Cancel a Bidit request. This cannot be undone: open offers are withdrawn and the businesses that bid are notified. Only call this when the customer explicitly asks to cancel.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_request, submit_request, get_request_status · Private data: find_category, get_bids · Public sink: create_request, update_request, submit_request, get_request_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_request, submit_request, get_request_status · Private data: find_category, get_bids · Public sink: create_request, update_request, submit_request, get_request_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "find_category" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
